perks.name: Rangefinder
perks.desc: Aiming this weapon increases its effective range and zoom magnification. Increased projectile velocity while aiming Rocket Launchers, Grenade Launchers, and Bows.

perks.name: Ambitious Assassin
perks.desc: Overflows the magazine based on the number of rapid kills before reloading.

perks.name: Fourth Time's the Charm
perks.desc: Rapidly landing precision hits will return two rounds to the magazine.

perks.name: Reconstruction
perks.desc: This weapon slowly reloads itself over time, up to double capacity.

perks.name: Air Assault
perks.desc: Final blows grant a stacking bonus to airborne effectiveness. Final blows while airborne grant increased stacks.

perks.name: Well-Rounded
perks.desc:
Throwing a grenade or hitting a target with a charged melee grants a stacking bonus to weapon stability, handling, and range.

Using a Super grants maximum stacks.

perks.name: Firmly Planted
perks.desc: Increased accuracy, stability, and handling when firing while crouched.

perks.name: Pulse Monitor
perks.desc: Automatically reloads the magazine and improves weapon handling when wounded—even when this weapon is stowed.

perks.name: Threat Detector
perks.desc: Increased reload, stability, and handling when enemies are in close proximity.

perks.name: Lone Wolf
perks.desc: Slightly improves aim assist, aim down sights speed, and airborne effectiveness. Increases these effects when there are no nearby allies.

perks.name: Bewildering Burst
perks.desc: Reloading this weapon after defeating a target causes the next hit to launch a Kinetic projectile that detonates into a disorienting blast.

perks.name: Shoot to Loot
perks.desc: Shooting an Orb of Power picks it up. Shooting an ammo brick picks it up and automatically reloads all of your equipped weapons from reserves.

perks.name: Vorpal Weapon
perks.desc: Increased damage against bosses, vehicles, and Guardians with their Super active.

perks.name: Harmony
perks.desc: Final blows with other weapons improve this weapon's damage and performance for a short duration.

perks.name: High-Impact Reserves
perks.desc: Rounds at the end of the magazine deal more damage.

perks.name: Gutshot Straight
perks.desc: Aiming down sights increases body shot damage, decreases target acquisition.

perks.name: Perfect Float
perks.desc: Being in combat for a moderate time increases airborne effectiveness and reduces flinch until you are out of combat.

perks.name: Redirection
perks.desc: Damaging rank-and-file combatants increases damage against more powerful ones.

perks.name: Feeding Frenzy
perks.desc: Each rapid kill with this weapon progressively increases reload speed for a short time.

perks.name: Osmosis
perks.desc: Using your grenade ability partially refills the magazine and changes this weapon's damage type to match your grenade until you stow it.

perks.name: Timed Payload
perks.desc: Projectiles attached to enemies explode after a short delay.

perks.name: Multikill Clip
perks.desc: Reloading grants increased damage based on the number of rapid final blows made beforehand.

perks.name: Explosive Payload
perks.desc: Projectiles create an area-of-effect detonation on impact.

perks.name: All-Star
perks.desc:
Collecting ammo loads this weapon from reserves and enhances its damage and reload speed for a duration.

Collecting Heavy ammo grants more time.

perks.name: Precision Instrument
perks.desc: Dealing sustained damage increases precision damage.

perks.name: Collective Action
perks.desc:
Collecting an Elemental pickup or destroying a Tangle grants this weapon a stacking period of increased damage. Throwing a Tangle provides additional time.

Elemental pickups include [Solar]Firesprites, [Void]Void Breaches, [Arc]Ionic Traces, [Stasis]Stasis Shards, and [Strand]Strand Tangles.

perks.name: Adhesive Ordnance
perks.desc: Collecting ammo loads an explosive round that adheres to surfaces, detonates shortly after impact, and applies exhaust.

perks.name: Frenzy
perks.desc: Being in combat for an extended time increases damage, handling, and reload for this weapon until you are out of combat.

perks.name: Rasputin's Arsenal
perks.desc: Breaking a target's shield partially reloads this weapon's magazine.

perks.name: Eyes Up
perks.desc:
This weapon gains reload speed, range, and slightly increased damage against combatants for a short time when combat begins.

Final blows extend and enhance this bonus.

notes: pandapaxxy (PvE / M+KB / Controller): "Precision frames lack a lot in PvE. Reconstruction and vorpal weapon will be the strongest combo, the Seventh Seraph Officer Revolver will fall off hard as the content gets more difficult. If we had seen frenzy I could recommend it higher. Without that damage perk it falls to the wayside." Recommended MW - Reload.

pandapaxxy (PvP / M+KB): "Rangefinder rolling in the third column is an interesting option. Being able to have one of the strongest PvP perks alongside a, somewhat middling, damage perk is incredible. It’s not going to have consistent three-taps like Survivor’s Epitaph or even the Ikelos hand cannon, it will have some extra punch at the tail end of its magazine." Recommended MW - Range.

pandapaxxy (PvP / Controller): "Rangefinder rolling in the third column is an interesting option. Being able to have one of the strongest PvP perks alongside a, somewhat middling, damage perk is incredible. It’s not going to have consistent three-taps like Survivor’s Epitaph or even the Ikelos hand cannon, it will have some extra punch at the tail end of its magazine." Recommended MW - Stability or Range.

[YeezyGT's S16] [MW: Range] "What a weapon. Honestly, recommending anything other than Timed Payload feels wrong. It is so, so good on 180RPMs, and you truly feel it as one of the best possible options when Overload Hand Cannons are in the mix. Some decent synergy perks in FTTC/Threat Detector/Firmly Planted that match the 180RPM playstyle. Max out the mag and Reload where you can, and just go to work. P.S: Warmind Cells." tags:god-pve
